script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the spies entered quietly or looked around inside the city.
The text does not say someone carried something into the city, or that the spies did not carry a note.
The claim that the rest of the plan waited until they were through the door adds an unspecified plan and timing.
The text says the man and his family were released, not that they walked away together.
The claim that Israel was supposed to drive the Canaanites out needs a reference to a passage that gives that instruction.
The verse says the Amorites were pressed into forced labor; it does not say the work of driving them out was never finished.
A whole land full of people who will never go away goes beyond the angel's words about thorns in their sides.
The angel says the gods will be a snare, not that they will set a trap.
Saying it would be nice if the other gods were a blessing conflicts with Papa Dorin's godly character.
Calling the moment quiet conflicts with the text saying the people lifted up their voices and wept.
The claim about people setting up stones in other Bible stories needs a reference.
The claim that trumpets appear at other moments in the Bible needs a reference.
The text does not say the ending was quieter than a trumpet blast.
